surprises: The reused ArtistsPage error banner offers only Retry, so inheriting the precedent quietly missed the acceptance's 'dismissible' requirement.
Reusing the shared handle-search input stacks its 350ms debounce on top of the panel's own applyDraft debounce, giving ~700ms latency inherited straight from the artists precedent.

proposed_rules.diff: + When reusing a shared filter/precedent component, check it against THIS phase's acceptance line by line before assuming parity — a shared precedent can silently violate an explicit requirement (e.g. a 'dismissible' warning that only offers Retry).

followups: P3: Make FilterOptionsError warning dismissible (add a close/dismiss action) on both InfluencersPage and the shared ArtistsPage precedent, since they share the component.
P3: Collapse the double debounce on handle search (HandleSearchInput 350ms + applyDraft 350ms ≈ 700ms) to a single debounce across both the influencer and artist filter panels.
